description:
Implement ordered-statistics decoding (OSD) — the near-ML baseline every short-code and GRAND paper is measured against, and the post-processing half of BP+OSD used across LDPC-family decoding.

## Background

OSD [Fossorier1995] decodes by most-reliable-basis reprocessing: sort received reliabilities, Gaussian-eliminate the generator matrix onto the most reliable independent positions, and test error patterns up to order $m$ over the resulting information set. Order-$m$ OSD approaches ML performance on short codes and is the reference baseline in short-blocklength decoder comparisons [Yue2022]. Combined with belief propagation it is also the accuracy workhorse of quantum-LDPC decoding [Roffe2020], so one implementation serves both the classical benchmark role and BP post-processing. The workspace has no OSD; existing GRAND results cannot currently be positioned against near-ML performance. The required primitives — dense GF(2) elimination with column pivoting, generator-matrix access, LLR handling — all exist.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Order-$m$ OSD decodes any linear block code exposing a generator matrix, producing hard decisions from soft input (LLRs), with $m$ configurable.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reproduces the documented near-ML performance of OSD on a reference short code (e.g. extended BCH $(128, 64)$) within simulation confidence intervals of published curves.
- [hard] REQ-03: Syndrome-guided OSD runs as a post-processor on belief-propagation failure, and the combined BP+OSD decoder is exercised on an LDPC code in tests.
- [aspirational] REQ-04: Complexity-reduction variants (pattern segmentation, discarding thresholds) with measured elimination/pattern counts.

## References

- [Fossorier1995] Fossorier, Lin — Soft-Decision Decoding of Linear Block Codes Based on Ordered Statistics. IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 41(5):1379–1396, 1995.
- [Yue2022] Yue, Miloslavskaya, Shirvanimoghaddam, Vucetic, Li — Efficient Decoders for Short Block Length Codes in 6G URLLC. arXiv:2206.09572.
- [Roffe2020] Roffe, White, Burton, Campbell — Decoding across the quantum low-density parity-check code landscape. Phys. Rev. Research 2:043423 (2020). arXiv:2005.07016.
title: Ordered-statistics decoding as the universal soft-decision baseline
